title: delegated-region-assertor-and-audit-tombstone
author: Aisha Khatri
body: Context: Customers with strict data residency requirements asked for a safer migration path from coarse-grained region pins to a delegated, auditable assertion model. This PR introduces a delegated region guard middleware and an audit consistency shim that allows operator-run services to attach short-lived region assertions, records a tamper-evident audit tombstone when region assertions are downgraded or proxied, and enriches KMS requests with a stable region_tag header for downstream attestation. Motivation: Current region pinning is brittle for operator workflows and causes noisy audit logs during multi-region failover. The goal is to provide a forward-compatible policy surface for RBAC v2 that supports operator delegation, provides clear audit semantics, and enables KMS to make region-aware decisions without coupling callers to implementation details. What this PR does (high level): - Adds a middleware delegated_region_guard that inspects incoming operator claims, validates delegation signatures (operator attestor keys), and emits a canonical region assertion into the request context. - Introduces an audit tombstone header X-Redwood-Audit-Tombstone written by gateways when a request switches region context due to operator delegation or fallback. The tombstone contains a short deterministic hash to enable later dedupe in the audit pipeline. - Enriches KMS call path to attach kms.region_tag and kms.attestor_id as stable request metadata used by the KMS broker for affinity and proofing. - Extends RBAC v2 policy compiler to support new condition region_delegation_allowed and an operator-supplyable allowed_regions list. - Provides a migration tool bin/region-delegation-migrate that rewrites existing tenant region pins into the new assertion format and emits a migration audit report. Implementation notes: Middleware lives in service/security/delegation/ and is approximately 350 LOC providing signature verification, TTL checks, and claim canonicalization. Policy compiler changes are localized to rbac/compiler/conditions.go and rbac/compiler/translator.go. The condition API is backward compatible: existing policies that reference tenant_region continue to work. Audit tombstone is produced in gateway/proxy/proxy_audit.go and marshalled to audit/ingest with a new tombstone_type field. Tombstones are intentionally compact (sha256 truncated to 16 bytes hex) to avoid payload bloat. KMS enrichment implemented in kms/proxy/metadata.go; when no attestor is present we set kms.region_tag to unspecified to preserve downstream semantics. Testing and verification: Unit tests cover signature validation, TTL and replay protection (new test files under delegation/). Integration tests added in infra/e2e/region-delegation.test cover successful delegated asserts, operator denial, and tombstone emission during fallback. Migration tool tested on a synthetic export (scripts/migration/testdata/) and a dry-run mode added (--dry-run). Rollout plan: Feature gated behind remote flag region_delegation_v1 initially off. Canary rollout to dedicated clusters for customers who opted-in for migration. Monitor audit tombstone rates (new metric audit.tombstone.emitted) and KMS region-tag usage. Backwards compatibility and migration: Existing tenant_region pins remain authoritative unless a tenant opts into delegation via the migration tool. The migrate tool produces a per-tenant report and can be reverted. QA checklist included to validate parity of billing and routing before enabling the gate. CI/Quality: Initial CI run failed due to flaky attestor key reload; fixed by adding a short jitter to the file watcher and retrying signature verification for the first second after startup. All checks now pass: unit, gofmt, linters, integration smoke. Security review summary: Threat model review done with Security (SEC-34). Main remediation: require operator attestor keys to be rotated regularly and present an audit TTL to prevent long-lived delegations. See SECURITY.md note in PR. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration e2e added - [x] Migration tool included with dry-run - [x] Feature-flagged rollout - [x] Security review completed - [x] Documentation updated (docs/security/region-delegation.md). Related work: see ENG-1124 (product migration) and SUP-9087 (customer support ticket for noisy failovers).
commits: RBAC compiler: add region_delegation_allowed condition and translator
Gateway: emit audit tombstone and wire into audit ingest pipeline
KMS proxy: attach kms.region_tag and kms.attestor_id metadata
Add migration tool with dry-run and per-tenant report
Fix flaky attestor key reload (add jitter/retry), update tests
review_thread: Marcus Li: The tombstone format needs a version byte so future changes remain parsable. Author: added a version prefix to the hash and updated ingestion code.
Priya Nair: Migration tool needs a safe revert path. Author: added --revert and per-tenant backup snapshots; noted in docs.
Owen Fitzgerald: Can we avoid emitting tombstones for internal system retries? Author: added gate to skip tombstone when X-Internal-Retry is present and documented the tradeoffs.
Marcus Li: Approve after addressing comments on key rotation TTL. Author: increased default delegation TTL to 15m and added rotation guidance in SECURITY.md. Marcus Li: Approved
Priya Nair: Verified e2e on canary cluster, logs looked good. Priya Nair: Approved
release_notes: Adds a delegated region guard middleware, audit tombstones for region delegation events, KMS region_tag enrichment, RBAC v2 condition region_delegation_allowed, and a migration tool to convert tenant region pins to delegation assertions. Feature gated and rolled out opt-in first.
